yusuf.d: Yusuf is a noble prophet in Islam and one of the sons of the prophet Yaqub (Jacob).

tongue.d: Tongue is one of the parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

yahya.d: Yahya is a noble prophet in Islam (known in the Bible as John the Baptist) and is the son of Zechariah.
